The Milwaukee Brewers won the most games of the six division leaders, with 103 wins. I read this from the MLB.com Standings page for the 2026 regular season, which shows the final standings as of Sep 27.

The six division leaders and their wins:

| Division | Leader | Wins |
|---|---|---|
| AL East | Tampa Bay Rays | 98 |
| AL Central | Cleveland Guardians | 85 |
| AL West | Houston Astros | 81 |
| NL East | Atlanta Braves | 94 |
| NL Central | Milwaukee Brewers | 103 |
| NL West | Los Angeles Dodgers | 100 |

ANSWER: Milwaukee Brewers, 103
